name: Neutral plasma
description: Equal numbers of positive (m = 10) and negative (m = 1) charges in a reflecting sphere, with electric and magnetic pair forces: Coulomb plus the magnetic force between moving charges (Biot–Savart with μ₀/4π = k/c², so parallel currents attract; the Darwin corrections and retardation are left out), under special relativity (Minkowski metric, c = 20) instead of a speed clamp. At these speeds magnetism is a few percent of the electric force. Lower c in the Spacetime dialog (try 6): the magnetic coupling k/c² grows with it, speeds saturate below c and the largest γ climbs past 2 (Spacetime shows it).
